title: Psalm 148: Heaven and Earth, Praise the LORD
summary: The psalmist summons the whole created order to praise the LORD: first everything above, angels, sun, moon, stars, and the highest heavens, then everything below, sea creatures, weather, mountains, trees, animals, and every human being from kings to children. The reason is that God made them all by his command, and that he has raised up strength for his own people Israel.

from.where: The Study Bible's introduction to the Psalms
from.text: on to a final crescendo in which every psalm from 146 to 150 begins and ends with Hallelujah, praise the LORD.

line: Everything above and everything below, angels, sun and stars, sea creatures, weather, mountains, kings and children, is called to praise the LORD who made them.
guide: Look up tonight; the sky praises God by being what he made it to be. You are in a choir with whales, hailstorms and kings. Invite someone old or young to praise with you.

stanzas.title: Praise from the heavens: angels, hosts, lights, and skies
Because God commanded and they were created
Praise from the earth: sea, weather, land, creatures, and all people
Because his name alone is exalted and he has raised up his people

verses.t: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,
young men and maidens, old and young together.
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
